# Reference compose for the service parser (serviceParser + updateCompose).
# Test-only: tests/Feature/ServiceParserReferenceTest.php parses it and compares the result
# with service-reference.expected.yaml. Each service covers one group of parser features.
services:
  # Domain with a port, magic secrets, all environment syntaxes, labels, volumes.
  web:
    image: nginx:alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_WEB_8080
      - LITERAL=plain-value
      - BARE_PASSTHROUGH
      - SELF_REF=${SELF_REF}
      - WITH_DEFAULT=${WITH_DEFAULT:-fallback}
      - REQUIRED=${REQUIRED:?REQUIRED must be set}
      - NO_BRACES=$NO_BRACES_VALUE
      - NESTED=${NESTED_OUTER:-${NESTED_INNER:-inner-default}}
      - NESTED_NO_DEFAULT=${NESTED_NO_DEFAULT_OUTER:-${NESTED_NO_DEFAULT_INNER}}
      - DASH_DEFAULT=${DASH_DEFAULT_VAR-dash-default}
      - NO_BRACES_DEFAULT=$NO_BRACES_DEFAULT_VAR:-no-braces-default
      - SHARED={{environment.SHARED_KEY}}
      - SHARED_MISSING={{environment.NOT_DEFINED}}
      - INTERPOLATED=http://${INTERPOLATED_HOST:-localhost}/path
      - PASSWORD=${SERVICE_PASSWORD_WEB}
      - PASSWORD_64=${SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_WEB}
      - PASSWORD_SYMBOLS=${SERVICE_PASSWORDWITHSYMBOLS_WEB}
      - BASE64=${SERVICE_BASE64_WEB}
      - BASE64_64=${SERVICE_BASE64_64_WEB}
      - REALBASE64_64=${SERVICE_REALBASE64_64_WEB}
      - PASSWORD_SYMBOLS_64=${SERVICE_PASSWORDWITHSYMBOLS_64_WEB}
      - REALBASE64_128=${SERVICE_REALBASE64_128_WEB}
      - HEX_32=${SERVICE_HEX_32_WEB}
      - HEX_128=${SERVICE_HEX_128_WEB}
      - SUPABASE_ANON_WITHOUT_JWT=${SERVICE_SUPABASEANON_KEY}
      - USER=${SERVICE_USER_WEB}
      - LOWERCASE_USER=${SERVICE_LOWERCASEUSER_WEB}
      - UNKNOWN_MAGIC=${SERVICE_FOO_WEB}
      - API_URL=${SERVICE_URL_API}
    labels:
      com.example.team: platform
      com.example.dollar: price-$5
      traefik.http.middlewares.reference-headers.headers.customresponseheaders.X-Reference: "1"
    volumes:
      - web-data:/usr/share/nginx/html
      - ./config:/etc/nginx/conf.d:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ./web-init.sh
        target: /docker-entrypoint.d/init.sh
        read_only: true
        content: |
          #!/bin/sh
          echo "reference fixture"
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://127.0.0.1:8080"]
      interval: 10s
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    env_file: custom.env

  # Path value with FQDN declaration, map-style environment, build args, ports.
  api:
    image: node:22-alpine
    build:
      context: .
      args:
        - BUILD_VERSION=${BUILD_VERSION:-1.0.0}
    environment:
      SERVICE_FQDN_API: /api
      MAP_LITERAL: map-value
      MAP_NULL:
      GHOST_URL: ${SERVICE_URL_GHOST}
      DB_URL: postgres://${SERVICE_USER_DB}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_DB}@db:5432/app
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - nfs-data:/mnt/nfs
      - type: bind
        source: ./api-data
        target: /data
      - type: bind
        source: ./optional
        target: /optional
        bind:
          create_host_path: false
    expose:
      - 3000

  # Hyphenated service name: SERVICE_URL_MY_APP maps to compose service "my-app".
  my-app:
    image: httpd:2.4-alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_MY_APP_80

  # Host www.example.com after the custom domain step (redirect to non-www in the settings case).
  www:
    image: nginx:alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_WWW

  # Ghost image with a path domain: extra redirect labels for the path.
  blog:
    image: ghost:5-alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_BLOG_2368=/blog

  # Shared host with path routing (Appwrite style): same variable, different paths.
  gateway:
    image: traefik/whoami
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_GATEWAY=/
  gateway-ws:
    image: traefik/whoami
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_GATEWAY=/ws

  # Exact copy of web's declaration (old Twenty template, #11924): no domain, no variable writes.
  worker:
    image: nginx:alpine
    command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_WEB_8080
      - APP_URL=${SERVICE_URL_WEB}

  # SERVICE_FQDN_ twin of web's SERVICE_URL_ declaration: also a copy.
  scheduler:
    image: nginx:alpine
    command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
    environment:
      - SERVICE_FQDN_WEB_8080
    exclude_from_hc: true

  # Database image: ServiceDatabase row, no domain, no proxy labels.
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=${SERVICE_USER_DB}
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${SERVICE_PASSWORD_DB}
      - POSTGRES_DB=app
      - SERVICE_URL_DB_5432
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - shared-external:/backups
    networks:
      - internal
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER}"]
      interval: 5s

  # restart "no": excluded from status checks; shares web's network namespace.
  sidecar:
    image: busybox
    restart: "no"
    network_mode: "service:web"
    command: ["true"]

volumes:
  web-data:
  db-data:
    driver_opts:
      type: none
      o: bind
      device: /srv/db
  shared-external:
    external: true
  nfs-data:
    driver_opts:
      type: nfs
      o: addr=10.0.0.2,rw
      device: ":/exports/data"

networks:
  internal:
  default:
  # Networks with aliases are not added to every service.
  aliased:
    aliases:
      - alias-name

# Reference compose for the service parser (serviceParser + updateCompose).
# Test-only: tests/Feature/ServiceParserReferenceTest.php parses it and compares the result
# with service-reference.expected.yaml. Each service covers one group of parser features.
services:
  # Domain with a port, magic secrets, all environment syntaxes, labels, volumes.
  web:
    image: nginx:alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_WEB_8080
      - LITERAL=plain-value
      - BARE_PASSTHROUGH
      - SELF_REF=${SELF_REF}
      - WITH_DEFAULT=${WITH_DEFAULT:-fallback}
      - REQUIRED=${REQUIRED:?REQUIRED must be set}
      - NO_BRACES=$NO_BRACES_VALUE
      - NESTED=${NESTED_OUTER:-${NESTED_INNER:-inner-default}}
      - NESTED_NO_DEFAULT=${NESTED_NO_DEFAULT_OUTER:-${NESTED_NO_DEFAULT_INNER}}
      - DASH_DEFAULT=${DASH_DEFAULT_VAR-dash-default}
      - NO_BRACES_DEFAULT=$NO_BRACES_DEFAULT_VAR:-no-braces-default
      - SHARED={{environment.SHARED_KEY}}
      - SHARED_MISSING={{environment.NOT_DEFINED}}
      - INTERPOLATED=http://${INTERPOLATED_HOST:-localhost}/path
      - PASSWORD=${SERVICE_PASSWORD_WEB}
      - PASSWORD_64=${SERVICE_PASSWORD_64_WEB}
      - PASSWORD_SYMBOLS=${SERVICE_PASSWORDWITHSYMBOLS_WEB}
      - BASE64=${SERVICE_BASE64_WEB}
      - BASE64_64=${SERVICE_BASE64_64_WEB}
      - REALBASE64_64=${SERVICE_REALBASE64_64_WEB}
      - PASSWORD_SYMBOLS_64=${SERVICE_PASSWORDWITHSYMBOLS_64_WEB}
      - REALBASE64_128=${SERVICE_REALBASE64_128_WEB}
      - HEX_32=${SERVICE_HEX_32_WEB}
      - HEX_128=${SERVICE_HEX_128_WEB}
      - SUPABASE_ANON_WITHOUT_JWT=${SERVICE_SUPABASEANON_KEY}
      - USER=${SERVICE_USER_WEB}
      - LOWERCASE_USER=${SERVICE_LOWERCASEUSER_WEB}
      - UNKNOWN_MAGIC=${SERVICE_FOO_WEB}
      - API_URL=${SERVICE_URL_API}
    labels:
      com.example.team: platform
      com.example.dollar: price-$5
      traefik.http.middlewares.reference-headers.headers.customresponseheaders.X-Reference: "1"
    volumes:
      - web-data:/usr/share/nginx/html
      - ./config:/etc/nginx/conf.d:ro
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock:ro
      - type: bind
        source: ./web-init.sh
        target: /docker-entrypoint.d/init.sh
        read_only: true
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "wget", "-qO-", "http://127.0.0.1:8080"]
      interval: 10s
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    env_file: custom.env

  # Path value with FQDN declaration, map-style environment, build args, ports.
  api:
    image: node:22-alpine
    build:
      context: .
      args:
        - BUILD_VERSION=${BUILD_VERSION:-1.0.0}
    environment:
      SERVICE_FQDN_API: /api
      MAP_LITERAL: map-value
      MAP_NULL:
      GHOST_URL: ${SERVICE_URL_GHOST}
      DB_URL: postgres://${SERVICE_USER_DB}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_DB}@db:5432/app
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - nfs-data:/mnt/nfs
      - type: bind
        source: ./api-data
        target: /data
      - type: bind
        source: ./optional
        target: /optional
        bind:
          create_host_path: false
    expose:
      - 3000

  # Hyphenated service name: SERVICE_URL_MY_APP maps to compose service "my-app".
  my-app:
    image: httpd:2.4-alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_MY_APP_80

  # Host www.example.com after the custom domain step (redirect to non-www in the settings case).
  www:
    image: nginx:alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_WWW

  # Ghost image with a path domain: extra redirect labels for the path.
  blog:
    image: ghost:5-alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_BLOG_2368=/blog

  # Shared host with path routing (Appwrite style): same variable, different paths.
  gateway:
    image: traefik/whoami
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_GATEWAY=/
  gateway-ws:
    image: traefik/whoami
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_GATEWAY=/ws

  # Exact copy of web's declaration (old Twenty template, #11924): no domain, no variable writes.
  worker:
    image: nginx:alpine
    command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_WEB_8080
      - APP_URL=${SERVICE_URL_WEB}

  # SERVICE_FQDN_ twin of web's SERVICE_URL_ declaration: also a copy.
  scheduler:
    image: nginx:alpine
    command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
    environment:
      - SERVICE_FQDN_WEB_8080
    exclude_from_hc: true

  # Database image: ServiceDatabase row, no domain, no proxy labels.
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=${SERVICE_USER_DB}
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${SERVICE_PASSWORD_DB}
      - POSTGRES_DB=app
      - SERVICE_URL_DB_5432
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - shared-external:/backups
    networks:
      - internal
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER}"]
      interval: 5s

  # restart "no": excluded from status checks; shares web's network namespace.
  sidecar:
    image: busybox
    restart: "no"
    network_mode: "service:web"
    command: ["true"]

volumes:
  web-data:
  db-data:
    driver_opts:
      type: none
      o: bind
      device: /srv/db
  shared-external:
    external: true
  nfs-data:
    driver_opts:
      type: nfs
      o: addr=10.0.0.2,rw
      device: ":/exports/data"

networks:
  internal:
  default:
  # Networks with aliases are not added to every service.
  aliased:
    aliases:
      - alias-name

# Reference compose for the service parser (serviceParser + updateCompose).

services:

    environment:

      - DASH_DEFAULT=${DASH_DEFAULT_VAR-dash-default}
      - NO_BRACES_DEFAULT=$NO_BRACES_DEFAULT_VAR:-no-braces-default
      - SHARED={{environment.SHARED_KEY}}

      - INTERPOLATED=http://${INTERPOLATED_HOST:-localhost}/path
      - PASSWORD=${SERVICE_PASSWORD_WEB}

  api:
    image: node:22-alpine
    build:
      context: .
      args:
        - BUILD_VERSION=${BUILD_VERSION:-1.0.0}
    environment:
      SERVICE_FQDN_API: /api
      MAP_LITERAL: map-value
      MAP_NULL:
      GHOST_URL: ${SERVICE_URL_GHOST}
      DB_URL: postgres://${SERVICE_USER_DB}:${SERVICE_PASSWORD_DB}@db:5432/app
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - nfs-data:/mnt/nfs
      - type: bind
        source: ./api-data
        target: /data
      - type: bind
        source: ./optional
        target: /optional
        bind:
          create_host_path: false
    expose:
      - 3000

  # Hyphenated service name: SERVICE_URL_MY_APP maps to compose service "my-app".
  my-app:
    image: httpd:2.4-alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_MY_APP_80

  # Host www.example.com after the custom domain step (redirect to non-www in the settings case).
  www:
    image: nginx:alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_WWW

  # Ghost image with a path domain: extra redirect labels for the path.
  blog:
    image: ghost:5-alpine
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_BLOG_2368=/blog

  # Shared host with path routing (Appwrite style): same variable, different paths.
  gateway:
    image: traefik/whoami
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_GATEWAY=/
  gateway-ws:
    image: traefik/whoami
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_GATEWAY=/ws

  # Exact copy of web's declaration (old Twenty template, #11924): no domain, no variable writes.
  worker:
    image: nginx:alpine
    command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
    environment:
      - SERVICE_URL_WEB_8080
      - APP_URL=${SERVICE_URL_WEB}

  # SERVICE_FQDN_ twin of web's SERVICE_URL_ declaration: also a copy.
  scheduler:
    image: nginx:alpine
    command: ["sleep", "infinity"]
    environment:
      - SERVICE_FQDN_WEB_8080
    exclude_from_hc: true

  # Database image: ServiceDatabase row, no domain, no proxy labels.
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=${SERVICE_USER_DB}
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=${SERVICE_PASSWORD_DB}
      - POSTGRES_DB=app
      - SERVICE_URL_DB_5432
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
      - shared-external:/backups
    networks:
      - internal
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER}"]
      interval: 5s

  # restart "no": excluded from status checks; shares web's network namespace.
  sidecar:
    image: busybox
    restart: "no"
    network_mode: "service:web"
    command: ["true"]

volumes:
  web-data:
  db-data:
    driver_opts:
      type: none
      o: bind
      device: /srv/db
  shared-external:
    external: true
  nfs-data:
    driver_opts:
      type: nfs
      o: addr=10.0.0.2,rw
      device: ":/exports/data"

networks:
  internal:
  default:
  # Networks with aliases are not added to every service.
  aliased:
    aliases:
      - alias-name
